## Order physical fills, exchange and corner refresh (`apply_boundaries; exchange_ghost_zones`) {#sec-ch11-timing}

<!-- PROVENANCE
pin: snapy@e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0
status: draft

### Summary

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
Physical fills and exchange have different owners. Reapply non-outflow x1 callbacks on exchange-owned tangential slabs so wall corners match the newly received state.
Default: called by initialization and stage paths.
Order: exact discrete operation or local derivation below; coupled solver order not measured.
:::

### Derivation

This is an operator-order contract. Copying neighbour values and applying a physical wall need not commute
at their overlap: exchange can overwrite a wall corner. Reapplying the wall map to the newly exchanged strip
restores the same parity relation as on the owned strip, provided the callback uses interior values and is
idempotent. The registry contract (`BC_FUNCTION`, [`bc_func.hpp:14-39`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/bc/bc_func.hpp#L14-L39)) and `refresh` ([`meshblock.cpp:951-978`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/mesh/meshblock.cpp#L951-L978)) encode these requirements.
C1 includes a two-dimensional corner where exchange overwrites a prior mirror and a restricted second fill
restores parity. This is an exact discrete ownership check, not a convergence proof.

The report-only checks are `src/snapy_report/ch11/boundary_check.py`; their current output is
`src/snapy_report/ch11/boundary_check.out`. They do not call a snapy kernel.

### Numerical method

Initialization captures the boundary background, fills primitives, exchanges them, converts to conserved
variables, records solid fill states and fills conserved fields. The standalone block `forward` exchanges
before advancing. `Mesh::forward` advances then exchanges; its multi-block fixer path fills physical boundaries
again after the shared correction. Each local advance refills solid hydro cells after the RK combine, performs
last-stage saturation adjustment when enabled, applies the fixer when not deferred, then fills physical faces.

The block exchange refresh uses only the first two (x1) callbacks, skips outflow, and restricts each call to
nonphysical tangential ghost slabs. Scalar primitive ratios are then recomputed. No accuracy order follows
solely from this sequence; wall rest and phase-change tests are the available assertions.

: Implementation sites for timing. {#tbl-ch11-timing-code}

1. Initialize and capture independent references before physical fills. The anchor `boundary_reference_w` is in [`meshblock.cpp:401-431`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/mesh/meshblock.cpp#L401-L431).
2. Use the ordering of the selected block or mesh forward API; do not assume their exchange calls occupy the same position. The anchor `advance_local` is in [`mesh.cpp:331-365`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/mesh/mesh.cpp#L331-L365).
3. After block exchange, refresh x1 wall corners with the conserved/scalar representation and recompute scalar ratios. The anchor `refresh` is in [`meshblock.cpp:951-978`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/mesh/meshblock.cpp#L951-L978).
4. At stage end, fill after enabled saturation adjustment and gravity correction. The anchor `apply_boundaries` is in [`meshblock.cpp:782-842`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/mesh/meshblock.cpp#L782-L842).

### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
Only x1 callbacks participate in this refresh; outflow is excluded. The public `Mesh::exchange_ghost_zones`
method only constructs sync options and calls exchange ([`mesh.cpp:389-395`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/mesh/mesh.cpp#L389-L395)), so callers cannot assume it supplies the
block method's refresh. Custom callbacks depending on the full orthogonal shape violate the documented contract.

Untested switch combinations remain subject to @sec-ch12-matrix. No new CPU, CUDA or multi-rank solver result is claimed.
:::
